title: Dick and Vallée precognize each other's work: VALIS and The Invisible College
summary: Eric Wargo tells of Dick and Vallée precognize each other's work: VALIS and The Invisible College, about 1974–1975 at an unknown place, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: other's work they were both writing uh in 1974 1975 that's when uh valet was writing the invisible college and that's when dick was writing the first draft of what became veis

plain: A researcher named Eric Wargo, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast in 2024, says the science fiction writer Philip K. Dick and the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée each seemed to foresee the other's work. According to Wargo, in 1974 and 1975 Vallée was writing his book The Invisible College while Dick was writing the first draft of what became his novel VALIS, and the two books echo each other. If true, it would suggest ideas can travel ahead in time between minds.
